ios.desc:
Experience the thrill of chess puzzles with Chess Blitz, & our vast collection of chess game. Play solo or connect with millions of chess players around the world in chess multiplayer mode. Suitable for all levels of chess players. Invite your friends & family to play online chess matches.

Chess, Ajedrez, Xadrez, Satranç, scacchi, Schach, Šah, Szachy, Sahmat, шахматы, Scacco, 国际象棋, Schack, fidchell, Skak, échecs, Shatranj, Schaken, Gwyddbwyll, Sjakk, شطرنج. with its various names it is known as the best strategy game played across the world.

Engage in exciting 2-player chess battles. From the intriguing checkmate in 1 puzzle to the complex endgame ches challenges. A chess game app for kids & for all ages, this game offers plenty of challenges and opportunities for you to practice chess and improve your skills. Time to play like a chess master. Engage in a unique Player versus Player mode of chess puzzles that offer challenges on different board sizes.

Get Hints and Undo Moves: You can receive hints for puzzles and even undo your chess moves. It’s all about learning and having fun! We firmly believe that every mistake presents a new learning opportunity.

Chess blitz lets you analyze your puzzle and view solutions. You can dive deep into your tactics and pinpoint exactly where you fumbled. And the best part? You get to learn some pretty clever strategies in the process!

Chess Blitz allows you to learn and understand various chess tactics, & strategies, all while engaging in captivating gameplay. Unlock new levels in the battle arena, earn daily rewards & watch your chess level ascend!

Game Features:
-Play with friends
-Battle for chess mastery
-Simple & Intuitive interface
-Get hints for chess puzzles
-Undo & review your chess moves
-View solutions
-Select chess game difficulty
-Unlock new arenas
-Level Up & earn rewards

Download and play Chess Blitz today to enhance your chess moves and experience the excitement of fast-paced chess puzzles!
Checkmate has never been this fun!

quotes.text:
Hello!
I'm a passionate chess enthusiast. I couldn’t find a platform that showcases and allows one to learn the best moves ever played in international matches. I wanted to create a game that does this while being enjoyable, swift, and competitive. Took sometime, but now my game is out on both iOS and Android.

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.superhugestudios.chessblitz.chessgame.friends.chess

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/chess-blitz-multiplayer/id6446757472

As this is my debut project, I'd greatly appreciate suggestions on how I can enhance and make the game better. What features would you like to be added?

Currently, I am using a AI bot to play as the opponent whenever there's a low concurrency, and also added a feature to invite friends to play against. I made a custom algorithm to calculate the ELO scores of the player based on how one plays, and place a puzzle into a particular ELO bucket as well.

I am also looking for people to help maintain a site I built, The Times of Chess (https://thetimesofchess.com/), to populate strategies and best stories around Chess.

Would love to hear from you and get your feedback! If you'd like to join me in developing this game further, do let me know! :)
